scenario: Declarative-only per LTAC.9.1 — `after 30_s: log info "ok"` declares a timer declaratively. Pin: it compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowering, so the follow-up rule is not observed.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "triggered"
    after 30_s:
        log info "ok"
